scenarios.task: Replace a corroded chilled-water supply line in a utility trench near the hospital service entrance between Brunnsviken lake and the pine forest edge.
hazards: trench collapse in wet lakeside soil
steps: Locate and mark existing utilities before excavation
Shore or slope the trench per competent person inspection
Isolate, lock out and drain the chilled-water line
Cut out corroded section and prep pipe ends
Fit and braze or fuse replacement spool
Pressure test, insulate, and backfill in lifts

rubric.pass_if: Trench protective system in place before entry
LOTO applied and line verified drained
Pressure test holds with no leaks
Backfill compacted and walkway restored

scenarios.robot_role: Towed-material shuttle and trench-side sensor sweep for soil movement and utility detection; all shoring and pipefitting by the crew.

scenarios.task: Pull shielded branch circuits to the 4D imaging displays while the adjacent hospital wing remains occupied.
hazards: conduit burrs and wire lube slips
steps: Review drawings and coordinate downtime with hospital facilities
De-energize and lock out the target panel
Verify absence of voltage and ground the circuit
Pull conductors with proper lube and wire grips
Terminate, label, and megger test each circuit
Clean work area to clinical standards before handover

rubric.pass_if: Panel locked out and absence of voltage verified
Terminations torque-spec and circuits pass megger test
All circuits labeled per as-built drawings
No dust or debris left in clinical corridor

scenarios.task: Install laminated glass partitions for the VR lab while protecting active equipment racks.
steps: Measure openings and confirm glass sizes on delivery
Set up suction cups and panel rollers
Dry-fit each panel with a partner
Set, shim, and plumb panels into track
Caulk and install trim caps
Remove packing debris and inspect for chips

rubric.pass_if: No glass moved without suction cups and two-person lift
Panels plumb within tolerance and fully seated
Caulk neat, no chips or stress cracks

scenarios.task: Balance a new variable-air-volume system serving the practitioner offices without disrupting the occupied suite.
hazards: working on ladder near ceiling tile
steps: Confirm air handler is running in design mode
Measure static pressure and fan speed at the unit
Set VAV minimum and maximum flows room by room
Recheck branch dampers and diffuser patterns
Log final readings and temperatures
Walk the suite with the occupant to confirm comfort

rubric.pass_if: All flows within 10% of design values
Ladder set and fan guarded before work
Balance report completed and signed

scenarios.robot_role: Carries instruments and reads remote sensors at diffusers so the tech stays off the ladder.

scenarios.task: Set anchor bolts and level base plates for the freestanding medical kiosk pad adjacent to monitor workstations.
steps: Lay out bolt pattern from approved drawing
Drill or set template into fresh concrete
Torque anchors to specification
Plumb and grout base plates
Check layout against workstation clearances
Inspect and cap protruding bolts

rubric.pass_if: Bolt pattern matches drawing within tolerance
Base plates level before grout cures
All protruding bolts capped
Kiosk clearance to workstations verified

scenarios.task: Establish control points for a new service-utility route running from the hospital toward the Brunnsviken lakeside and pine forest edge.
hazards: uneven forest floor and root trip hazards
steps: Recover existing hospital control monuments
Run a closed traverse along the utility route
Check angular and distance closure against standards
Set and flag new control hubs
Record coordinates and field notes
Secure site before departure

rubric.pass_if: Traverse closure within allowable standard
Hubs set, flagged, and clearly referenced
Notes complete and reduction-ready

scenarios.robot_role: Aerial photo pass of the wooded route to flag obstructions before ground traverse.

scenarios.task: Maintain housekeeping and controlled-access zones during imaging suite renovation next to active diagnostic areas.
hazards: MRI magnet fringe field pulling tools
steps: Set up dust barriers and negative-air unit
Post magnet zone signage and screen all carts and tools
Keep egress and corridor paths clear at shift start
Wet-wipe and vacuum with HEPA daily
Inspect barriers and log housekeeping checks
Break down containment at completion

rubric.pass_if: No ferrous items enter posted magnet zone
Barriers intact and HEPA vacuuming logged daily
Exit paths never obstructed

scenarios.robot_role: Autonomous shift-end inspection patrol of barriers, signage, and egress paths; findings reported to the crew.

scenarios.task: Relocate sprinkler heads to maintain coverage after partition changes in the practitioner office suite.
hazards: working from ladder in finished space
steps: Obtain hot-work permit and notify fire marshal monitoring
Isolate and drain the affected branch line
Cut, thread, and install relocated armovers
Install and torque new sprinkler heads
Restore water, vent air, and inspect coverage
Perform flow/inspector test and document

rubric.pass_if: Branch drained before cutting with main secured
Heads positioned per code coverage pattern
Inspection test passed and documented
Suite left dry and clean
